newsitem.title: USA: Thermo completes Life Sciences tender offer.
newsitem.headline: Thermo completes Life Sciences tender offer.

text.p: Thermo Instrument Systems Inc said on Wednesday it completed its tender offer for Life Sciences International Plc, having received acceptances from 90 percent of Life Sciences' outstanding shares.
The total value of Thermo's tender offer for Life Sciences' 175 million outstanding shares is 236 million sterling.

Life Sciences, based in London, makes laboratory science products. Thermo makes instruments to measure air pollution, radioactivity and other things, and to control and monitor various industrial processes.
Thermo Instruments is a public subsidiary of Thermo Electron Corp.
